whatTheyRecorded.Instructions.docx: r – Run “UnrealEngineInstaller.msi” For silent installation: you can find instructions here Install Unreal Editor to C:\VT\Unreal\5.5 including the following packages: [IMAGE 2] Adding Cardiac Plugin Copy paste folder Cardiac to C:\VT\Unreal\5.5\Engine\Plugins\Marketplace\ Modify C:\VT\Unreal\5.5\Engine\Config\BaseEngine.ini Add new Section with following parameters: [Cardiac] ServerURL="https://uecardiac.wob.vw.vwg" HBPeriod=10.0f MaxAttempt=10.0f Add following line in Section [HTTP] HttpProxyAddress="" Add following line in Section [/Script/Engine.NetworkSettings] n.VerifyPeer=False Adding Bridge Plugin Copy and paste folder Bridge to C:\VT\Unreal\5.5\Engine\Plugins [IMAGE 3] (reference) Adding FAB Plugin Copy and paste folder Fab to C:\VT\Unreal\5.5\Engine\Plugins [IMAGE 4] (reference) Disabling ZenServer communication Modify C:\VT\Unreal\5.5\Engine\Config\BaseEditorSettings.ini Modify following variable [/Script/UnrealEd.CrashReportsPrivacySettings] bSendUnattendedBugReports=False Disabling TraceServer Delete “C:\VT\Unreal\5.5\Engine\Binaries\Win64\UnrealTraceServer.exe” Suggest to reboot (Soft-Reboot) Be aware that the installation will be executed in „SYSTEM“ context (this is not a real user) and that additional configuration steps might have to be carried out for a user.
